labels.name: Iliac crest
labels.function: Upper bony rim of the hip bone; ends in front at a palpable spine

labels.name: Gluteus medius
labels.function: Abducts and medially rotates the thigh; keeps the pelvis level

labels.name: Superior gluteal nerve
labels.function: Injury drops the pelvis to the unsupported side (Trendelenburg)

labels.name: Piriformis
labels.function: Laterally rotates the extended thigh; landmark at the nerve exit

labels.name: Inferior gluteal nerve
labels.function: Supplies the main hip extender used for stairs and rising

labels.name: Sciatic nerve
labels.function: Leaves the pelvis below the landmark rotator to the posterior thigh

labels.name: Superior gemellus
labels.function: Small lateral rotator sharing its nerve with the muscle just below

labels.name: Obturator internus
labels.function: Its own nerve also supplies the small rotator just above it

labels.name: Inferior gemellus
labels.function: Small lateral rotator innervated by the nerve to the muscle below

labels.name: Quadratus femoris
labels.function: Lowest deep rotator; its nerve also supplies the muscle above

labels.name: Greater trochanter
labels.function: Insertion site of the pelvic-stabilizing abductors

labels.name: Ischial tuberosity
labels.function: Bears weight when sitting; origin of the posterior thigh muscles

labels.name: Rectus femoris
labels.function: Extends the knee and, crossing the hip, assists hip flexion

labels.name: Vastus intermedius
labels.function: Knee extensor lying directly on the front of the bone

labels.name: Vastus lateralis
labels.function: Knee extensor wrapping the outer side of the thigh

labels.name: Vastus medialis
labels.function: Knee extensor on the inner front of the thigh

labels.name: Sartorius
labels.function: Flexes, abducts, laterally rotates the thigh and flexes the knee

labels.name: Adductor longus
labels.function: Adducts the thigh and assists hip flexion

labels.name: Gracilis
labels.function: Adducts the thigh; crosses the knee to aid flexion, medial rotation

labels.name: Adductor magnus
labels.function: Two parts with dual innervation: one adducts, one extends

labels.name: Semimembranosus
labels.function: Deep medial hamstring; medially rotates the flexed leg

labels.name: Semitendinosus
labels.function: Superficial medial hamstring from the sitting bone

labels.name: Biceps femoris
labels.function: Laterally rotates the flexed leg; two heads, two nerve divisions

labels.name: Sciatic nerve
labels.function: Supplies the posterior compartment through two divisions

labels.name: Lateral condyle of femur
labels.function: Outer rounded articular surface of the distal thigh bone

labels.name: Medial condyle of femur
labels.function: Inner rounded articular surface of the distal thigh bone

labels.name: Anterior cruciate ligament
labels.function: Stops the tibia sliding forward on the femur

labels.name: Posterior cruciate ligament
labels.function: Stops the tibia sliding backward on the femur

labels.name: Medial collateral ligament
labels.function: Resists valgus stress; attached to the inner pad of cartilage

labels.name: Lateral collateral ligament
labels.function: Resists varus stress, a force that drives the knee outward

labels.name: Medial meniscus
labels.function: Torn with its attached ligament and the forward-limiting cruciate

labels.name: Lateral meniscus
labels.function: Outer pad: improves congruency and absorbs shock

labels.name: Fibula
labels.function: Lies beside the knee but does not take part in the joint

labels.name: Tibial tuberosity
labels.function: Receives the ligament carrying quadriceps force from the kneecap
